body.objective: Make acquisition of a scientific work lease unmistakably deliberate, while preserving an efficient noninteractive resident loop and providing an idempotent recovery path for an incumbent lease.
body.stop_condition: Add a deterministic read-only preview such as `s-f work next --stream S --agent A --now T` that prints the exact next item, dependency reason, current gate, expected package path and a content-addressed claim token without appending an event or lease. Make the mutating claim require an explicit acknowledgement of that preview, such as `work pull --accept-item I --claim-token H`, or an equivalently conspicuous automation flag; a bare query-shaped invocation must not acquire work. The accepted claim must atomically acquire exactly the previewed item or refuse if queue order, dependency fold, item head, agent lease state or token changed. Require or automatically emit a complete work package on every successful claim. If the same agent already holds the live lease, return an idempotent RESUME result and re-emit the package without appending another ACTIVE or ACQUIRE event. Add a safe resident `work unclaim`/yield path for a lease with no WORK_REPORTED checkpoint, with an explicit confirmation and append-only release/READY events; never infer release from elapsed time. Extend overview/agent-status with a distinct `LEASED_UNSTARTED` disposition when a live lease has no checkpoint by its holder, and do not attach an older agent's report as the current holder's checkpoint. Provide deterministic both-backend fixtures for preview-only no-mutation, accepted claim, stale token, queue-order race, already-held resume, accidental repeated pull, unstarted unclaim, long-running proof with no automatic release, and checkpoint attribution by holder.
body.current_gate: deliberate lease acquisition and honest incumbent-start diagnostics
body.forbid: no automatic lease release based only on time or missing checkpoints; no interactive prompt required in headless automation; no weakening atomic/CAS pull semantics; no hidden `--yes` default; no second state fold; no checkpoint attributed across agent identities; no physics-specific stream or item special case
activates: safe unattended resident startup and reliable queue monitoring
body.resource_hint: RESIDENT SAFETY PAPER CUT. Reuse the authoritative queue preview, CAS guard and agent-to-live-lease index; this is a deliberate-claim protocol, not a new scheduler.
notes: ACCEPTED 2026-07-21 (science-forge). Split into two halves. HONEST-DIAGNOSTICS HALF LANDED (master 939d58a0b): `s-f work show` is now HOLDER-SCOPED — a lease held by an agent with no WORK_REPORTED renders `LEASED-UNSTARTED — holder <A> holds the lease but has filed NO WORK_REPORTED`, and a PRIOR holder's report is explicitly labelled a prior holder's, NEVER attributed to the current holder (the exact classical-1/classical-2 confusion). A holder WITH a report is attributed to it; a released lease falls back to the any-agent report with '(no lease currently held)'. New clock-free `current_holder` (max-seq lease agent iff last action ACQUIRE/RENEW). Gate: run.sh LEASE-UNSTARTED (unstarted + attributed + released-fallback + C==native); ASan-clean. Immediate recovery is the existing resident-authored `s-f work yield --item I --agent A --now T` (append-only release; never time-inferred), now documented in WORKER-GUIDE.md under `work show`.

DEFERRED — the PREVENTION HALF is a separate phase (mirrored into the tango program as sf:program/work/SF-deliberate-work-claim): a deterministic read-only `s-f work next` preview + a content-addressed claim token; a bare query-shaped `work pull` must NOT acquire (deliberate `--accept-item I --claim-token H` or an equally conspicuous automation flag); atomic CAS acquire-or-refuse on (queue order, dep fold, item head, lease state, token); idempotent already-held RESUME with no duplicate ACTIVE/ACQUIRE; a safe `work unclaim`; and the overview/agent-status LEASED_UNSTARTED disposition. This half CHANGES `work pull` semantics for all existing automation and depends on bug-science-forge-pull-transition-cas-race, so it warrants its own careful landing + the full both-backend fixture set (preview-no-mutation, accepted claim, stale token, queue race, resume, repeated pull, unstarted unclaim, long-proof no-auto-release, holder attribution). No auto lease release by time/missing-checkpoint; no hidden --yes; no second state fold; no cross-identity checkpoint attribution.

Exact physics reproduction 2026-07-21: classical-2 invoked sfc work-pull at 06:47:24Z and acquired classical-berger-q26-104-row-free-adjoint-completion through 14:47:24Z, but later reported that it had not undertaken the item. No WORK_REPORTED checkpoint by classical-2 exists; work-show misleadingly displayed an older classical-1 checkpoint.

Exact physics reproduction 2026-07-21: classical-1 invoked sfc work-pull at 07:44:40Z and acquired classical-two-phase-counterflow-repaired-q70-generic-isotypical-health through 11:44:40Z, but later reported that it had not undertaken the item. No checkpoint exists. The append-only events prove explicit pull invocations, so this is not a phantom lease; it is an overly easy query-to-mutation transition.
Immediate recovery is resident-authored `s-f work yield --item I --agent A --now T`. The coordinator must not impersonate the resident while the coordinator revoke/reassign protocol remains unlanded.

Follow-up exact reproduction 2026-07-21: a fresh classical-1 ACQUIRE at 08:16:13Z was displayed as having a current classical-1 WORK_REPORTED checkpoint, but the displayed report predates that acquire and belongs to an earlier lease cycle. `LEASED_UNSTARTED` must be scoped to the current ACQUIRE epoch, not merely to the stable agent ID: only a WORK_REPORTED or WORK_COMMITTED event occurring after the current ACQUIRE and attributable to that holder/session may mark the current claim started. Historical checkpoints by the same stable agent must be labelled prior-cycle evidence.
